title: Answer six design choices
summary:
It planned due follow-ups.
1. Move a due follow-up to Needs you? It recommends yes.
2. Name: it recommends to-do.
3. Resolution record: it recommends a new table.
4. Follow-ups on groups: it recommends refusing them.
5. Icon for plain notes: it recommends yes, dimmed.
6. Stale session brings up its follow-up? It recommends no.
It needs all six.

decisions.question: Should a due follow-up move the session to Needs you?
decisions.context: That adds 1 to the badge and sends one notification for each follow-up, at the moment it's due.
